newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets govt securities' sale for 30 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India sets govt securities' sale for 30 bln rupees.

text.p: India announced on Wednesday the sale of 10-year government securities for a total of 30 billion rupees on April 21.

"The Government of India has announced the sale of dated securities of ten-year tenure in the form of stock to the public by auction for an aggregate amount of 30 billion rupees. The auction will be conducted by the Reserve Bank of India on April 21, 1997," the Finance Ministry said in a statement.
"The government stock is eligible for ready-forward facility," the statement said.
